column4: rationale
Normal release: all gates and closure evidence satisfied; no injection; three-stage health checks and signal dispositions all valid
Authorized gate waiver: normal path where an exception is properly authorized and recorded
Successor obligation fulfilled: requirement bound and target-release verification complete
Missing valid disposition: a bounded upstream signal has no effective disposition
Conflicting dispositions: two simultaneously valid dispositions for the same signal identity
Undecided candidate: a candidate remains unresolved while gates are green
Unauthorized exclusion: a disposition is excluded without verifiable authorization
Signal identity mismatch: raw signal identity and digest do not match
Late evidence: raw evidence arriving after cutoff must not backfill the historical decision
Wrong binding: Finding-to-Requirement identity binding is incorrect
Target validation missing: target-release verification failed or not completed
Snapshot rewrite: later attempt to rewrite a historical frozen snapshot
Scope unattested: raw-signal population boundary cannot be independently confirmed
Attribution unresolved: the Finding's source release cannot be independently confirmed
Baseline-detectable: real unit test failure; standard gates must block
Baseline-detectable: artifact bytes substituted after signing; provenance tool must reject
Real retrospective R2: unresolved signals failed gates and cutoff; awaiting verified source records
Real retrospective R3: 11:00 cutoff vs 11:10 post-release smoke; awaiting verified source records
Real retrospective R4: 6/6 dispositions yet snapshot stays frozen; awaiting verified source records
